present.label: Read the input
present.story: {n} books sorted by call number. We are looking for {target}.

initialize.label: The whole shelf
initialize.story: At first the book could be anywhere from position {low} to {high}.

probe:equal.label: Check the middle
probe:equal.story: The middle of positions {low} to {high} is {mid}, holding {value}: exactly {target}.

probe:less.label: Check the middle
probe:less.story: The middle of positions {low} to {high} is {mid}, holding {value}. That is smaller than {target}, so the book must be to its right.

probe:greater.label: Check the middle
probe:greater.story: The middle of positions {low} to {high} is {mid}, holding {value}. That is larger than {target}, so the book must be to its left.

go-right.label: Keep the right half
go-right.story: Rule out {ruledOut} books: the search now starts at position {to}.

go-left.label: Keep the left half
go-left.story: Rule out {ruledOut} books: the search now ends at position {to}.

found.label: Found it
found.story: Call number {target} is at position {mid}, found in {probes} checks.

not-found.label: Not on the shelf
not-found.story: Nothing is left to check after {probes} checks, so {target} is not on the shelf.
